claim.purpose: Implement corrective issue #5756 MiniMax billing classification scope fix

initial.title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][providers] Scope MiniMax billing classification to MiniMax responses
initial.goal: Scope MiniMax billing classification so bare 1008 substrings in other hosted provider non-2xx responses do not become ProviderBillingBlocked.
initial.required_outcome: MiniMax code 1008 remains non-retryable ProviderBillingBlocked, while OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, and generic provider bodies containing 1008 retain their normal provider-specific classification and retry behavior.
declared_scope: adl/src/provider_adapter.rs shared hosted HTTP failure classification
authority_boundary: typed C-SDLC v2 binaries own lifecycle state
operator_constraints: do not write tracked files on primary main
publish a ready PR with Closes #5756
do not block on asynchronous closeout
initial.task_boundary: Implement the smallest provider-aware fix for the global non-2xx bare substring 1008 bug and add positive MiniMax plus negative cross-provider tests.
deliverables: OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, and generic negative regressions
focused provider tests and strict Clippy evidence
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Only a validated MiniMax response can produce MiniMax insufficient-balance classification.
AC-2: OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, and generic provider errors containing 1008 retain their provider-specific retry/classification behavior.
AC-3: Focused provider-adapter tests and strict Clippy pass.
AC-4: The PR body includes Closes #5756.
AC-5: No AWS use and no /private/tmp; all work remains in the issue worktree.
initial.plan_summary: Bind #5756, remove the global bare-1008 billing shortcut from the shared HTTP classifier, add MiniMax positive and cross-provider negative regressions, validate, review, and publish a ready corrective PR.

steps.action: Initialize and bind #5756 lifecycle in the issue worktree.
Add MiniMax positive and OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, and generic negative regressions.
Run focused provider tests, strict Clippy, diff hygiene, review, and publish.

invariants: MiniMax structured status code 1008 remains non-retryable billing blocked.
Shared non-2xx hosted provider classification does not classify bare 1008 as billing blocked.
Validation artifacts remain under .csdlc/evidence/5756 in this worktree.
risks: Over-broad text matching could still classify unrelated providers as billing blocked.
Tests could accidentally exercise retry exhaustion instead of first-attempt classification.
stop_conditions: focused provider tests fail after scoped fix
publication fails closed on stale review or remote drift

validation_lanes.proof_role: Focused provider adapter regression tests for MiniMax and cross-provider 1008 classification.
Strict lint proof for the touched provider adapter crate surface.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed, preserve request/evidence artifacts, and report the typed blocker without widening scope.
review_prompts: Verify the shared non-2xx classifier can no longer map bare 1008 text to ProviderBillingBlocked for non-MiniMax providers.
Verify MiniMax structured status_code 1008 remains non-retryable ProviderBillingBlocked.
Verify tests cover OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, and generic provider responses containing 1008 without relying on live credentials.
